messages.content: 你能估計2020年印度孟加拉虎的人口數量嗎？並將其與同年肯亞非洲象的估計人口數量進行比較，然後估計這兩種物種在各自國家的當前年份的人口數量嗎？

function.name: estimate_population
function.description: Estimate the population of a particular species in a given country. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Then estimate current year populations. We need to use the function. The function signature: estimate_population({species: string, country: string, year?: number}). So we need to call it for species "Bengal tiger" in "India" for year 2020. Then for "African elephant" in "Kenya" for year 2020. Then for current year 2026 for both species.

We should call the function twice for 2020 and twice for 2026. Then produce a comparison. The function returns any; presumably numeric estimate. We'll just call it. Use the function.
